title: dipladenia fragrans
intro: Dipladenia fragrans, commonly known as Mandevilla, is a flowering evergreen vine native to South America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, due to its therapeutic actions such as vasodilation and antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents present in Mandevilla include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the plant's effects and potential uses.
